# Lane `prose-fill-persons`: every `person/*` record to completeness 3, ar+en+ur

**Programme.** `docs/delegation/prose-fill-programme.md` (prose-fill, approved 3 Nov 2026). This lane owns **all `data/person/*` records** — missing prose and thin (<800 bytes) — raised to `status.completeness: 3` with full sourced Arabic prose and English + Urdu prose in the same commit.

**Queue.** `docs/delegation/prose-queue/person.md`, regenerated by `npx tsx scripts/report/prose-queue.ts` after every large merge. The lane works **bottom-up**: the zero-link tail first, ascending by inbound links. The head of the person queue (highest links) belongs to `prose-backfill-2`, which works top-down — the two meet in the middle; the boundary (last slug worked by this lane, next head position of `prose-backfill-2`) is restated in both progress files at each regeneration. Records logged done in any lane's progress file are never reworked; records in `docs/delegation/showcase-prose-progress.md` are skipped.

**What each person gets.** `content/ar/person/<slug>.md` in the person house structure (`## موجز` first — lineage, milieu, teachers/students, works, dates, death where recorded — following existing full person pages), plus `content/en/` and `content/ur/` files in the same commit, all `status.review: published` with `provenance`. Facts cite the sources the record already names — al-A'lam (Zirikli), Wafayat al-A'yan (Ibn Khallikan), Isaba/Tahdhib (Ibn Hajar), Tarikh al-Islam, Sallabi's biographies, the Muwatta/hadith rijal works — all on the harvest drive; a record citing only `source/wikidata` gets a real book source or is logged as a lead. Dated variants are kept as `status: debated` claims, not silently picked.

**Batches.** ≤25 records per commit, grouped by source so one book is mined once (e.g. a batch of Wafayat entries, then a batch of Isaba entries). Each commit: `npm run cite-check` on the batch ids, `npm run validate` (0 errors), `npm test`, `npm run coverage` regenerated in the same commit, explicit paths, attribution trailers, push `content/prose-fill-persons`, PR, self-merge.

**Stubs / progress.** `data/_stubs.d/prose-fill-persons.yaml` (append-only; narrators/teachers the prose names who have no record). Progress `docs/delegation/prose-fill-persons-progress.md`: one line per batch — files written, leads (with reason), next queue position. Commit prefix `content(prose-fill-persons)`.

**Rules.** `AGENTS.md`, `docs/agents/workflow.md`, `docs/agents/content-standards.md`, `docs/agents/mining-sources.md`, `docs/agents/publication-standard.md` (citations + provenance are the whole bar; no review gate). A person's faith is recorded only with its basis; no honorifics typed; no Qur'an text.
